quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 19

questions.question: You must pull over and let an emergency vehicle pass:

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: You must pull over to the right and stop for an emergency vehicle with flashing lights. This applies whether it is behind you or coming toward you.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to go in that direction.

questions.question: You may use your horn when you:
questions.explanation: Use your horn if you lose control of your vehicle. This alerts other drivers to the danger.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road.

questions.question: If an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is near you, you should:

options.text: Speed up to stay away from it.
Stop right away and block its path.
Do everything you can to clear the path for it.
Signal to let it know when it can pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do everything you can to clear the path for it.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is nearby, clear the path for it. Pull to the side of the road if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: If you see an animal on the road, you should:

options.text: Pass as close as possible to the animal.

questions.explanation: Be very careful when you see an animal on the road. Pass it slowly to avoid scaring it.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means you should:

options.text: Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and go when it is safe.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means "be careful." Slow down, look both ways, and proceed with care.

questions.question: You are on a divided highway with many lanes and see or hear an emergency vehicle. You should:

options.text: Ignore the signal if other lanes are open for it.
Stop as fast as you can.
Slow down, move over to clear a path, and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move over to clear a path, and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights, slow down, clear a path, and stop. Do not try to outrun the emergency vehicle.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the other lane is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going the same direction. You can cross a broken white line to pass if the other lane is clear.

questions.question: Pedestrians have the right-of-way:

options.text: When crossing an alley or driveway.
If they are using a cane.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at intersections in crosswalks. They also have the right-of-way when using a sidewalk across an alley or driveway. Blind pedestrians using a white cane or guide dog always have the right-of-way.

questions.question: Your tire blows out while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Hold the steering wheel tightly and slow down gradually.
Turn on your emergency flashers and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel tightly and slow down gradually.
questions.explanation: Do not brake suddenly during a blowout. Grip the steering wheel firmly and stay in your lane. Slow down gradually by releasing the accelerator. Once you are moving slowly, brake lightly and pull off the road to a safe spot.

questions.question: Two solid white lines mark a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Cars have the right-of-way over pedestrians.
Pedestrians in the crosswalk have the right-of-way.
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk.
Pedestrians must stay out of the way of all traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians in the crosswalk have the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show pedestrians where to cross safely. You must always stop for pedestrians who are in a crosswalk.

questions.question: Two solid yellow lines on the road mean:

options.text: Drivers from both directions can pass.
Passing is allowed at the top of a hill.
Passing is allowed during daylight only.

questions.explanation: Yellow lines mean traffic on the other side is moving toward you. Never cross two solid yellow lines to pass, no matter which direction you are going.

questions.question: A bus is signaling to return to the road after stopping. You must:

options.text: Honk to let the driver know you are there.
Speed up to pass the bus.

questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus that is signaling to return to the main road after stopping. Change lanes, slow down, or stop to let the bus merge safely.

questions.question: To check your blind spot before turning left, you should look:
questions.explanation: To check your blind spot, look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.

questions.question: Your car hits a parked car and you cannot find the owner. You must:

options.text: Leave, since you tried to find the owner.
Leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked car and cannot find the owner, you must leave a written note. Include your name, address, and details about the accident.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of traffic crashes?
questions.explanation: Crashes often happen when drivers do not see other vehicles or do something unexpected. Communicate with other drivers to help prevent crashes.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black words or symbols. They warn drivers about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you there is a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: When riding in a vehicle, small children:

options.text: Can be safely held by an adult.
Are safe standing on the floor in the back.
Will not be hurt in an accident because they are small.
Must never ride standing in the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must never ride standing in the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Children need special car seats. No person can safely hold a child during an accident or sudden stop. Always use a proper seat to secure children in a vehicle.

questions.question: What should you do when another car's headlights are too bright?

options.text: Use your bright lights until the other car dims theirs.
Flash your lights on and off to warn the other driver.
Dim your lights and speed up to pass quickly.
Look toward the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: If another car has its high beams on, look away from the headlights. Look toward the right side of the road instead. This keeps you from being blinded until the car passes.

questions.question: What should you do if your vehicle's right wheels leave the pavement?

options.text: Pull completely off the road and get back on when safe.
Speed up and steer back on the road quickly.
Release the accelerator, slow down, then ease back onto the road when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the accelerator, slow down, then ease back onto the road when safe.
questions.explanation: If your right wheels leave the pavement, do not panic. Release the accelerator and steer parallel to the road. Slow down and ease back onto the road with both hands on the wheel. Use a small steering adjustment. Check for traffic before steering back onto the pavement.

questions.question: What does a red traffic light mean?
questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop before entering the intersection. You must also stop at the stop line and before entering any crosswalk.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Broken lines mean drivers next to the line can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What is the safest way to drive in traffic?

options.text: Change your speed to stay alert.
Drive with the flow of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other vehicles. Always drive with the flow of traffic and stay within the posted speed limit.
